title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 83
description: Ten questions on Psalms 83: a prayer that God will not keep silent while many nations plot together against his people.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God not to do in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "God, don't keep silent. Don't keep silent, and don't be still, God."

questions.text: What have those who hate God lifted up?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

questions.text: What do the enemies want, according to their words in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 quotes them: "let's destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more."

answers.text: That Jerusalem may become a heap of ruins
That Israel may serve them as slaves
That the temple may be burned with fire
That the name of Israel may be remembered no more

questions.text: Whose tents are named together with the Ishmaelites in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 mentions the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites.

questions.text: Which great nation does verse 8 say is also joined with them?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "Assyria also is joined with them."

questions.text: At which river does verse 9 place Sisera and Jabin?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon."

questions.text: Where did they perish, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they perished at Endor and became as dung for the earth.

questions.text: Complete verse 11: "Make their nobles like Oreb and ..."
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb."

questions.text: In verse 13, what does the psalmist ask God to make them like?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind."

answers.text: Wax that melts before the fire
Tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind

questions.text: What should the enemies come to know, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.

answers.text: That Yahweh alone is the Most High over all the earth
That Israel can never be defeated by any nation
That their own gods are nothing but idols of wood
That Zion will stand forever among the nations
